data.name: Dash_DeepScan_Tip
data.value: Deep Scan (file signatures) arrives in Phase 4.

data.name: Dash_ScanNote
data.value: Quick Scan finds deleted files on NTFS drives. Deep Scan arrives in a later phase.

data.name: Tip_1
data.value: Stop using the affected drive immediately after data loss to reduce the risk of overwriting.

data.name: Tip_2
data.value: Never recover files onto the same drive you are scanning.

data.name: Tip_3
data.value: Recovery is not guaranteed. Overwritten data may be unrecoverable.

data.name: Tip_4
data.value: SSD TRIM can make deleted data impossible to recover.

data.name: Tip_5
data.value: Encrypted storage may prevent recovery; physically damaged drives may need a professional lab.

data.name: Drives_Subtitle
data.value: Detected drives. Reading drive details is read-only and never modifies your data.

data.name: Drives_None
data.value: No fixed or removable drives were detected.

data.name: Drives_Failed
data.value: Drive detection failed. See the log for details.

data.name: Drive_Scan_Tip
data.value: Looks for deleted files in the NTFS file table. Read-only; needs administrator rights.

data.name: Drive_Verify_Tip
data.value: Opens the drive read-only and reads its first sector. Needs administrator rights.

data.name: Warn_Trim
data.value: SSD with TRIM enabled: deleted files may be permanently erased and unrecoverable.

data.name: Warn_SsdNoTrim
data.value: SSD / flash media: recovery chances are usually lower than on a hard disk.

data.name: About_Status
data.value: Phase 3 build: NTFS Quick Scan and file recovery. Deep Scan and FAT32/exFAT support are not implemented yet.

data.name: About_Limits
data.value: Recovery is never guaranteed. Overwritten data may be unrecoverable, SSD TRIM can permanently erase deleted data, encrypted storage may prevent recovery, and physically damaged drives may need professional recovery.

data.name: About_Compat
data.value: Compatibility with Windows 7 SP1, 10 and 11 is not claimed until it has been tested on those systems.

data.name: Drive_Scan_NotNtfs
data.value: Quick Scan supports NTFS drives only. FAT32 and exFAT support arrives in a later phase.
